Storage pricing is broadly 50-75% below AWS EBS and Azure Managed Disks at equivalent performance tiers. [...] ### Block Storage and Object Storage

Block Storage at $0.10/GB/month for provisioned volumes; Object Storage at $5/month for first 250GB plus $0.020/GB/month beyond (S3-compatible API). Typical enterprise deployment storage cost runs 12-22% of compute cost, materially lower ratio than AWS EBS + S3 at equivalent scope. Negotiate storage commitment discounts of 10-15% on multi-year commitments.

### Egress Bandwidth [...] ### What discount is achievable on Linode / Akamai Cloud?

Committed-use discounts run 10-22% for 1-year commitments and 22-35% for 3-year commitments on top of already-discounted list pricing. Strategic deals above $1M annual or with Akamai edge delivery consolidation unlock 30-45% additional discount via enterprise license agreements.

### How does Linode / Akamai Cloud pricing compare to AWS, Azure, and GCP?

Compute prices 40-60% below AWS and Azure at equivalent vCPU/RAM configurations, 15-25% below GCP, roughly on par with DigitalOcean and Vultr. Storage and egress pricing carries the largest competitive advantage: egress is bundled with compute (free up to substantial caps) versus per-GB egress at AWS ($0.09/GB default). High-egress workloads see >60% TCO delta.

## Storage And Networking Costs

### Block Storage

Block storage is $0.10/GB-month. A 100 GB attached volume therefore adds about $10/month before backups or transfer. Delete unused volumes after deleting an instance because attached and unattached storage can continue billing.

### Object Storage [...] ### Object Storage

Object storage is listed at $0.02/GB-month. The first 1 TB of outbound transfer is included, followed by $0.005/GB egress. Accounts using less than 250 GB of object storage have a $5 monthly minimum for the service.

### Load Balancers And Kubernetes

NodeBalancer costs $10/month or $0.015/hour. High-availability Linode Kubernetes Engine control planes cost $60 per cluster per month, while LKE Enterprise is listed at $300 per cluster per month. Worker nodes, storage and traffic remain separate costs.

### 5 What is Akamai Cloud pricing in 2026?

Akamai Cloud uses straightforward, predictable pricing with no hidden fees. As of 2026, plans start at $5/month for a shared CPU Nanode instance (1 vCPU, 1GB RAM, 25GB SSD). Dedicated CPU plans start at approximately $36/month, and GPU instances are available from $350/month for workloads like machine learning or video processing. One of its biggest advantages is low egress fees — Akamai applies CDN-like economics to data transfer, making it significantly cheaper to move data than on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. All compute plans bundle CPU, RAM, storage, and transfer into a single monthly price.

### 6: How many data centres does Akamai Cloud have in 2026? [...] ### 4: Is Akamai Cloud good for small businesses?

Yes, Akamai Cloud (formerly Linode) is well-suited for small to medium-sized businesses. It offers transparent flat-rate pricing starting from $5/month, a developer-friendly control panel, and 24/7 award-winning support without additional cost. Studies by Peerspot show that small and mid-sized enterprises make up the majority of Akamai Cloud’s user base. Its NodeBalancer, managed Kubernetes, and object storage features also provide room to scale without the complexity or cost of hyperscalers like AWS or Google Cloud.

### 5 What is Akamai Cloud pricing in 2026? [...] For small businesses, Akamai Cloud is generally more affordable and simpler than AWS. Akamai Cloud plans start at $5/month with flat, predictable pricing — CPU, RAM, storage, and transfer are all bundled. AWS uses a complex pay-as-you-go model where costs can be difficult to predict. Akamai Cloud also offers free 24/7 phone support at no additional cost, while AWS charges extra for premium support tiers. However, AWS offers a much broader range of managed services (serverless, AI/ML, analytics) which may be needed by larger enterprises.
